name: Gsd Plugin
description: Get Shit Done Plugin - handles large codebase contexts - structured workflow plugin for Claude Code with 60+ slash commands, 21 agents, MCP server, hooks, and cross-session memory
longDescription:
Ships **86 skills**, **33 agents**, **6 hooks** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (86): `add-backlog` (Add an idea to the backlog parking lot (999.x numbering)), `add-phase` (Add phase to end of current milestone in roadmap), `add-tests` (Generate tests for a completed phase based on UAT criteria and implementation), `add-todo` (Capture idea or task as todo from current conversation context), `ai-integration-phase` (Generate AI design contract (AI-SPEC.md) for phases that involve building AI systems — framework selection, implementation guidance from…), `analyze-dependencies` (Analyze phase dependencies and suggest Depends on entries for ROADMAP.md), `audit-fix` (Autonomous audit-to-fix pipeline — find issues, classify, fix, test, commit), `audit-milestone` (Audit milestone completion against original intent before archiving), and 78 more
- **Agents** (33): `gsd-advisor-researcher` (Researches a single gray area decision and returns a structured comparison table with rationale), `gsd-ai-researcher` (Researches a chosen AI framework's official docs to produce implementation-ready guidance — best practices, syntax, core patterns, and…), `gsd-assumptions-analyzer` (Deeply analyzes codebase for a phase and returns structured assumptions with evidence), `gsd-code-fixer` (Applies fixes to code review findings from REVIEW.md), `gsd-code-reviewer` (Reviews source files for bugs, security issues, and code quality problems), `gsd-codebase-mapper` (Explores codebase and writes structured analysis documents), `gsd-debug-session-manager` (Manages multi-cycle /gsd:debug checkpoint and continuation loop in isolated context), `gsd-debugger` (Investigates bugs using scientific method, manages debug sessions, handles checkpoints), and 25 more
- **Hooks** (6): `SessionStart`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `PreCompact`, `Stop`, `SubagentStop`
- **MCP servers** (1): `.mcp.json`

Installs with `claude plugin install gsd-plugin@claude-community` from `jnuyens/gsd-plugin`.
